dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm, there's gotta be some wild herbs around here...

choices.text: Xiangling, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's you! Wow, thank you so much! It's beautiful!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: By the way, sounds like you and Hu Tao were up to something on the night of Lantern Rite... She didn't go into detail, but it must have been big.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I thought we were gonna grab dinner together that night. I set up a whole table of food and everything.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I waited until midnight, but nobody came! So, my dad offered to wait outside while I went to bed.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I tried to keep watch with him, but it was late, and at that point, I couldn't keep my eyes open...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Then, I had a dream that Hu Tao was standing in front of me, brushing my hair with the branch of a peach blossom tree and singing some kind of weird song.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I wanted to grab her and ask her what was going on... But, I couldn't move or make a sound...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: In the end, I shouted "don't you scare me, Hu Tao!", nearly flung myself off the bed, and scared my dad all at once.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry for making you worry.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hah, so you admit it! Luckily, Xingqiu filled me in later. He said you were working on some kind of array.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: That's not exactly my... thing, but it sounds complicated. By the end, you were probably so hungry you couldn't see straight!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Honestly, you need to start taking care of yourself! I could've at least packed you some rice buns for the road!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hm... Your punishment is to eat at my place for the rest of the festival!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Okay, see you around!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hmm, there should be some wild herbs around here...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Don't forget to come eat at my place, {NICKNAME}! I need to test out some new recipes! The flavors will blow your mind — that's a promise!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank goodness everything worked out...

choices.text: Lan Yan, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: #For me? Thank you, {NICKNAME}, it's beautiful!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wishing you all the best in the new year.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Likewise! I hope this year treats you well!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Although... I'm sure you're someone who can take that into your own hands.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: I have no doubt that you can turn any bad situation on its head.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: As expected of the great hero of Liyue and the esteemed guest of the Tianquan — your words exude confidence.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Anyway, you and Hu Tao solved the problem with the border, and now my grandpa doesn't need to worry about getting yelled at because of his fortunes.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: In that sense, I guess this year's Lantern Rite was a huge success!

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: I wish you health, success, and happiness in the new year!

choices.text: If I set my mind to it, of course.

response.speaker: Lan Yan
response.text: Bye! Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Lan Yan
dialogues.text: Wishing you all the best for the new year!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Maybe... I should attend an advanced cultivation session...

choices.text: Chongyun, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: A gift envelope? Thank you, I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Apologies... I've been busy recently, so I don't have one for you in return... All I can do is offer you my wishes in person.

choices.text: I wish you all the best, as well.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yes... Considering my family, I have some understanding of exorcisms and demons. But, I'm ashamed to say I never anticipated the connection between Xingqiu's great-grandfather and the problem with the boundary of life and death.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If I had more knowledge, or noticed something earlier, maybe you and Hu Tao wouldn't have needed to take those risks.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I should attend an advanced cultivation session soon...

choices.text: But, don't worry. It's been a busy time...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Bye! I wish you all the best in the coming year.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: If I want to do an advanced cultivation session, I need a mentor... But who...?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, perfect timing. I was just about to go look for you.

choices.text: Xingqiu, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Thank you! Wow, your penmanship is beautiful! Much better than mine...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Every Lantern Rite, the Feiyun Commerce Guild sends gift envelopes to our business partners...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Great-grandpa always writes them by hand as a sign of respect. His calligraphy is a sight to behold — so sharp and elegant.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: In the eyes of our business partners, his envelopes are more valuable than any gift. They even frame them and put them on display.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I suppose, in this case, the pen might even be mightier than gold.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How's he feeling? Any better?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Much better, thanks to you. He has enough energy to scold me for my lack of penmanship, that's for sure.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: He also said I should follow your example, strive to become a young hero like you...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Eventually, my brother came over and distracted him so I could slip away. Otherwise, he might have nagged me until the end of time...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hahaha, I appreciate that, but there's no need to be so polite. It's too old-fashioned for my taste.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I'll give you my gift envelope in a few days. I just need to wrap up a few things at home, and then we can grab a meal with Xiangling to celebrate.

choices.text: We can learn from each other.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: See you around. The mountain roads can be dangerous, so be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #I'll be in touch soon, {NICKNAME}! Once I finish my gift, I'll come find you.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Phew... After some fresh air, I feel a lot more awake.

choices.text: Keqing, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Thank you! I was actually in the middle of making one for you!

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But, uh... As soon as I sat down, work started to pile up. In the end, I only got a few words down...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Well, you deserve something substantial, too. I'll finish it soon.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: The matter with the boundary has been resolved, and Ningguang managed to cover it up in the name of a ritual, so we don't have to worry about mass panic...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: But, we still made quite the commotion that night, enough for some nearby hunters and mountain-dwellers to take notice.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: If anyone who caught a glimpse of fetor or the array start spreading senseless rumors, we could be in trouble...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: *sigh*... Look at me, talking about all this during the holiday season. You must be tired. Here, have some dim sum — it's fresh from Xinyue Kiosk.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I have things to discuss with Ganyu soon, but once I'm done with my envelope, I'll make sure to get it to you.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: #Happy Lantern Rite, {NICKNAME}. Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: ...How many files do I need to review? I should do a recount.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Thank goodness Liyue is still safe and sound...

choices.text: Ganyu, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: #It's lovely! Thank you, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: It's all thanks to you that we managed to get through this crisis.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was a group effort.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Phew... In any case, I'm glad everyone is safe.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Speaking of which, how are you holding up? Any tiredness or pain?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm doing fine, thank you.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: I'm glad... When Keqing and I heard that Director Hu had to carry you to Bubu Pharmacy — that you were unconscious — we rushed over there immediately.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Thankfully, Baizhu reassured us it was just exhaustion. It was a huge relief.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Still, you should be careful. If you feel unwell over the next few days, come find me, and I'll take you to see Cloud Retainer.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: She may not be known for her skill in medicine, but the adepti are knowledgeable and resourceful in all kinds of fields, so I'm sure she can help!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: #Happy Lantern Rite, {NICKNAME}. See you later!

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #If you feel unwell over the next few days, {NICKNAME}, come find me, and I'll ask Cloud Retainer to take a look at you.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The worst is over, and now... I can relax.

choices.text: Ningguang, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Thank you. Ah, just as expected — it's exquisite!

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The fetor problem could have had grave consequences. But, thanks to you and Director Hu, we were able to resolve it without issue.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Allow me to thank you again on behalf of all Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Many in this world claim to be heroic, but it takes a true hero to step forward in times of crisis.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Liyue Harbor is truly fortunate to have received the help of so many heroes.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: ...Anyway, I won't force you to listen to my compliments any longer. I want you to actually enjoy the festivities — that includes the food, too.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The crisis is over, so take it easy and make the most of the festival.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Goodbye. I hope you a have a relaxing Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Now, to deal with the aftermath...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Phew... It's almost time to head back to the ship.

choices.text: Beidou, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, not too shabby! I like the style, and nice penmanship!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: #Looks like your skill with a pen is just as good as your skill with a blade, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm just glad that everyone is safe.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Haha, with your help, that's practically a guarantee!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm not the only one impressed by your feats. My crew is dying to have a drink with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: My tolerance isn't that high, I fear...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Don't worry — I already got 'em off your back.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: You're fierce on the battlefield. But, when it comes to alcohol, my crew would drink you under the table.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Still, you should join us for a meal when you're free — I'll host.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: In the meantime... I've gotta get back to the ship. I just received payment from the Tianquan, so it's time to divide it among the crew.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Once I do that, I'll start prepping our feast! I'll be in touch.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: No backing out, you hear?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: See ya! I'll get everything ready for the feast, so no backing out!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hm, I've kept the crew waiting too long... I should get back.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: This medicine is all set... I'll have Herbalist Gui deliver it in a bit.

choices.text: Baizhu, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: That's very considerate, thank you. How have you been feeling the past few days?

choices.text: All good, thanks to your miraculous skills.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: There was nothing miraculous about it — simple medical treatment, nothing more.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Your constitution is strong. You were covered in fetor, but your cardiovascular system remained unaffected.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: The real miracle is the fact that you walked away from the array with no lasting damage... *cough* *cough*

choices.text: Are you okay? Please have some water.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: *cough*... *cough*... Don't worry, it's just exhaustion — I stayed up all night writing prescriptions.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: *sigh* Which is exactly why you need a break. Relax, or your body will pay the price.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Hehe, there's no need to worry. I know what I'm doing.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Come find me if you begin to feel unwell. I can provide you with some restorative medicine.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Never forget — even minor symptoms can be important warning signs.

response.speaker: Changsheng
response.text: How about taking your own advice? Staying up all night — you need some restorative medicine of your own.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: It's alright, Changsheng. I know what I'm doing.

choices.text: Did you use Changsheng's secret art again?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: That's good to hear. Standard medical texts offer little information on the treatment of fetor. I had to rely on ordinary methods.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Take care! Now that the crisis is over, you should get some rest and enjoy the festivities.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Come find me if you begin to feel unwell. I can provide you with some restorative medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Even minor symptoms can be important warning signs. Remember that.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You're here.

choices.text: Xiao, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Thank you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Your breathing is steady, and your footsteps are light — looks like you made a full recovery.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Still, your actions were too reckless. You should reflect on your lack of regard for your safety...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I wasn't there in the moment, but through the witness sigil, I was able to sense your actions.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I could tell you entered the array and took on the force of the blast on behalf of the young girl from Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: In any case, I'm glad you were unharmed.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Now, I can put my worries to rest.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Monsters driven mad by fetor could still attack, so I should patrol the area.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: If you run into trouble...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Alright, take care.

choices.text: I'll leave the patrolling to you.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If anything happens, remember to call my name.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: What fine tea...

choices.text: Zhongli, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Thank you. You're here at the perfect time — Director Hu brought me a pack of premium, aged "Iron Vermillion." It just finished steeping.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you for the hint earlier.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hah, your thanks are unnecessary — it was your sharpness of mind that put it to good use.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Many deserve thanks on this occasion — Director Hu for her steadfastness, the Ministry of Civil Affairs for their leadership...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: As a consultant, all I did was help Director Hu prepare a few gift envelopes and fortune coins.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Not to mention, we have you to thank for Director Hu's safe return. So, if anyone is to offer thanks, that person should be me.

choices.text: Huh? Is that how it is?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #The tea is ready, {NICKNAME}. Please, have the first cup and indulge me with stories about your recent endeavors.

choices.text: How did you... make this about me?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: May you have a blessed Lantern Rite. Take care!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Care for some tea? I'm quite curious about your recent endeavors.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ooh, where should I go next? This whole place is so lively...

choices.text: Amber, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Wow, a gift envelope! Thank you! I heard the people of Liyue exchange them during Lantern Rite as blessings.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's beautiful! I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you here for the festival, specifically?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sure am! Jean said we worked really hard this year. She thinks we all deserve a break, so she set up a rotating calendar for us to take time off.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Eula and I got our turn the last couple of days, so we came to Liyue Harbor as soon as we heard about the festivities.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No lack of hustle and bustle — or fun things to do — on the streets, huh?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yep! We spent a lot of time roaming around the city. We just split up so we could go get souvenirs for everyone at the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I bought a ton of stuff! A fan for Jean, a teacup for Lisa, a kite for Klee...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh and, this is for you! Grilled Tiger Fish — it's super delicious. Here, try some! I just bought it, so it's still warm!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hurry, before it gets cold! I'm gonna keep shopping, okay?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Fan, teacup, kite... What am I missing? Oh, right! Jewelry...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: See ya! Come find me the next time you're in Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey... you know what? We could just glide to Mondstadt right now...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This should be enough...

choices.text: Eula, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: #This is... for me? Thank you, {NICKNAME}! This is the first time I've received something like this.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I didn't expect to run into you here. Amber and I just split up to go shopping. We're bringing back gifts for everyone at the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you get?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Some small trinkets and toys. Oh, and some tea for Jean. It's from Qiaoying Village.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I heard that tea also has an energizing effect, so I thought it might be a nice change of pace for her.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Still, the brewing process for this kind of tea is pretty complicated. The vendor had to spend a lot of time explaining it to me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Thankfully, I already knew a bit about tea etiquette, so I caught on relatively quick.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Here, this tea cake is for you — it's from Qiaoying Village. Amber really liked it, so I decided to buy some.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: We're going to check out the Mingxiao Lantern later. Maybe we'll ask someone to take a picture for us.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I would do it myself, but unfortunately, neither of us brought a Kamera.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Goodbye! Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Too bad we didn't bring a Kamera...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: This lantern is so pretty...

choices.text: Yoimiya, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wow, so this is a gift envelope... So pretty! Thank you, it's going straight into my collection!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Seeing you here, getting this gift... Guess it was worth the trip after all!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh. Was this not a good enough time for you?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No no, it's not that! The food is delicious, and there are so many fun things to do. It's just...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: *sigh* I heard, during previous Lantern Rites, there were huge firework shows or tons of Xiao Lanterns.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But, not this time. I thought that huge tree-like lantern might shoot out fireworks at any moment...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Still, Lady Tianquan's ritual was super impressive, and the lights were beautiful.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, at the next festival in Inazuma, I'm gonna put on a giant light show, too!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I'll let you know ahead of time and save you the best seat in the house, so don't miss out!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Yep, see ya!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: These lanterns are so pretty. I wonder how they're made...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Gift envelopes, hmm... gift envelopes...

choices.text: Cyno, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Thank you. Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uhh... Same to you?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hm.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: What's with the look on your face?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: No, not at all.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I'm just following local customs.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Well, considering your gift...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I thought it best not to... "push the envelope"...

choices.text: Did you have a bad time?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I hear, the more envelopes you receive, the more luck you have in the new year. Do you know why?

choices.text: I—I'm not sure I really want to ask...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Well, because when that happens...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: The cards are really stacked in your favor.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well... I hope the cards are stacked in your favor this year, Cyno.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. With the way I play? Always.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: What should I get...?

choices.text: Tighnari, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Ah, I didn't expect to see you here, {NICKNAME}. Thank you for the envelope — it's lovely.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Enjoying the festival?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno and I have had a great time. We ate a lot of delicious food and bought quite a few gifts.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Unfortunately, the Harbor is a little too busy this time of year. If I stay around the commotion for too long, my ears start to hurt.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: So, I came over here for a break.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno said he needed to be alone for a while to think about something.

choices.text: Oh... a case of some sort?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: No, I don't think so...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: He kept mumbling about "gift envelopes," so odds are, he's trying to come up with a new joke...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: How do you even make a joke out of something like that...?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Bye! I'm going to look for Cyno. *sigh* Let's hope he's not feeling too inspired today...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Thanks for the envelope — it's lovely. I'll take good care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: What should I get...?

choices.text: Tighnari, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Ah, I didn't expect to see you here, {NICKNAME}. Thank you for the envelope — it's lovely.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Enjoying the festival?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno and I have had a great time. We ate a lot of delicious food and bought quite a few gifts.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Unfortunately, the Harbor is a little too busy this time of year. If I stay around the commotion for too long, my ears start to hurt.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: So, I came over here for a break.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Cyno said he needed to be alone for a while to think about something.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He... came up with another joke...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Tighnari all about Cyno's envelope joke...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: *sigh* No surprise there...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Thanks for the warning, {NICKNAME}. At least I can mentally prepare myself this time...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Thanks again for the envelope — it's lovely. I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Bye! I'm going to look for Cyno. *sigh* Let's hope he's not feeling too inspired today...

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: The design of this lantern is exquisite... Definitely worth the trip.

choices.text: Chiori, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Oh, for me? Thank you.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Ah... Lovely detail around the border. Looks like you put a lot of care into this — thank you, I'll take good care of it.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: By the way, do you know who designed this lantern?

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: It's beautiful, and the way the light shines through is so imaginative.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I wonder if the design took inspiration from some of Liyue's ancient legends... I feel like I've seen similar patterns in a book before.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: I'd love to speak with the person who made it. I might even get some ideas for a new collection along the way...

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Alright, I'm going to ask around.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Huh... Which ancient legend is referenced in this design?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Weird... Why can't I find any clues?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Huh? OH! Great Hero of Liyue! Perfect timing!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: C'mon, I have so much to ask you! Don't worry — completely off the record...

choices.text: I—I'm just here to give you a gift envelope!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Ah, thank you for this — it's beautiful. Now, onto the real business at hand.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: You know about the ritual Lady Tianquan conducted, right?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I've asked around, and everyone says it's one of this land's traditional ceremonies. But, I also heard it hasn't been performed in a long time.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Not to mention, as the ritual was starting, I saw a flock of birds scatter in the mountains near the harbor, and a strange light coming from the forest...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Ah, it's all thanks to my Kamera. I bought an ultra-telephoto lens not too long ago — definitely came in handy just now!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Unfortunately, it was super dark, so the photos are too blurry to make out anything...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: #That's why I was hoping you could fill me in, {NICKNAME}. Is there anything you can tell me? Doesn't have to be right now — you can write me a letter if you remember something...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Here, take this. Think of it as... an advance.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I'll treat you to a meal back in Fontaine, too! How does that sound?

choices.text: D—Don't smile at me like that!
Yeah. I'll, ah, see you around, I guess?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Bye! I'm going to ask around some more...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Next time you're in Fontaine, I'll treat you to a meal!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Hmm... What should I write on this gift envelope...

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Ugh, what is this? When I'm up to my eyebrows in work, bright ideas cling to me like dead skin, but now that the festive season's upon us, they've all sloughed off and fled for the hills!

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: I was going to ask some Linling for some special ideas, but... You know what, I'd rather find a book of this year's popular festive phrases and just copy that.

dialogues.speaker: Nervous An
dialogues.text: Forget it, there's still some time. I can just... find some work for which I can apply overtime. Maybe that'll bring the inspiration rushing right back.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: When is Daddy coming back? Is it too late to write him and ask him for some fortune coins?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: My friends and I have already done some fortune coin swaps. Seems like there are only ten or so varieties...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Daddy's gone off to a far away place, so there's gotta be some different ones over there, right?

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Of course, I shan't be writing him just some ordinary letter either. It's gotta be a gift, uh... Ugh, what did they call it again...

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Anyway, it'll be a letter full of words that bring blessings!

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Heh, doubtless, the city is more festive.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: The heroes we commemorate during Lantern Rite are actually adepti who lived in Liyue in the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: If you have heard the new opera that's out this year, you should know about the "Sanctification of Tao Dou."

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: I was just thinking... Since Rex Lapis is both a god and The Prime of Adepti, isn't it possible that there'd be other gods amongst the adepti...?

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Of course, the "Eight Adepts" this time have more mortals amongst them than adepti, hah.

dialogues.speaker: Musheng
dialogues.text: Still, no matter who you are, good heroes from all walks of life, please watch over us here in Liyue, and grant us your blessings!

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Um... Have you figured it out yet?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm afraid not.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I've been working here for a long time, but Liyue's local sayings are still a mystery to me.

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: That's true. Makes you wonder, doesn't it — why would you sometimes use "wealth" as part of will-wishes, and sometimes as an invective...?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: ...I'd say we'd be better off not dwelling on that.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I mean, something like "love" is expressed in many different languages, but the meaning that we mean to convey is the same, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Vlad
dialogues.text: Yes, you're right, of course. You know what? That's a good line — wouldn't look out of place on a gift envelope at all, I'd say!

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: Ah, Liyue Harbor sure is livelier now that the ceremony's over.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I heard some gossip that the start of this year was an unlucky time, which had something to do with many people falling ill. Even had me feeling nervous back there.

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: But as it turns out, it wasn't a big deal after all, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Kun
dialogues.text: I've heard that the ceremony this time was a most important one, requiring in-person attention from skilled adepts of many different specialties. So forget a normal year, the one to come's going to be a blast for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Hah, would you look at all this newness around us? So long as enough people participate in any activity, even those who weren't interested to start with will get sucked in, like moths to a flame.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I mean, just look at the gift envelopes at the fair.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: In previous years, people would just buy them ready-made for exchange with family and friends, but now that there's a stand at which you can make 'em yourself, even those of us least fond of books are getting in on the action.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Of course, watching them scratching their heads trying to figure out some nice words to pen down is pretty funny. But I reckon that you can write anything you want, as long as it comes from the heart.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew. Lantern Rite sure is a tiring time. Best I go get some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But a strange anxiety seems to take me whenever I stop...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I had to prepare so many extra ritual supplies this year on top of last years' items... My workflow is getting real stretched here.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: The longer my list of tasks, the more stressed I get, so I've got to hurry and shorten it as soon as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: Hello. I... you... cat... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... For some reason, every cat and dog in Liyue Harbor got all antsy over the last few days, running around and yelping from morning till night...

dialogues.speaker: Yong'an
dialogues.text: It's gotten better most recently, but my allergy is still... ATCHOO! Sorry... ATCHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh my, if it isn't an old friend. Did you come all this way just to see me?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh, I kid. But really, you do look so lovely each time we meet.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I heard about the ceremony. I meant to ask if things went well, were we to meet, but your mood tells me they did.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: The danger is past, blessings lie ahead. Of course, things may not turn out smoothly throughout the year, but the best is yet to be, wouldn't you say?

dialogues.speaker: Minglan
dialogues.text: #Would you like to participate in a martial arts demonstration, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I'd love to give it a try!

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: Great. In that case, please, follow me.

choices.text: Let me think it over first...

response.speaker: Minglan
response.text: That's alright. Just let me know when you want to give it a whirl. I'm sure the Sergeant would be more than happy to have you.

dialogues.speaker: Yaolu
dialogues.text: Sorry! "Immortal Combat" isn't quite ready yet, so please come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Oh wow... Is it just me, or are there a lot more guests arriving to enjoy Lantern Rite than last year...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what exactly is this stall?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Hello there! This is the "Gift Envelope Consultancy" specially set up by the Ministry of Civil Affairs!

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Do you know about gift envelopes? They are a tradition here in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: We make them every Lantern Rite and give them to our family and friends, sending them our best wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've seen that lots of tourists from other nations have arrived for this year's Lantern Rite, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: They're interested in gift envelopes, and they all want to give the tradition a try themselves... But understandably, they don't know the first thing about making them.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: In response, the Ministry has sent me here to set up the Consultancy... on account of my penmanship, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Whether you want to make a gift envelope to send good wishes to kith and kin, or if you'd like to leave a commemorative envelope for yourself, you can come seek me out for help.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I can even help add Guyan Sigils to your envelope, or perhaps draw some patterns onto it... In these things and more, I shall help you as far as I am able.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do many people come to you for help?

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: Oh, lots. So many foreign guests have come in to have envelopes written up that I've had to get a new notepad just to record all their names.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: But there are just way too many clients. Apart from those who request that I write everything for them, there are also many who ask for suggestions for their well-wishes...

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: I'd love to have someone to help me out here, but I am well aware the Ministry has no spare manpower during Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Weijin
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you help me look at the requests that I recorded on my pad? If you could help me settle some of these commissions, that would be better still...

response.speaker: Weijin
response.text: Wonderful! Thank you for your help. Please, have a look at these commissions.

choices.text: I've got other things going on right now...

response.speaker: Weijin
response.text: That's fine. If you're willing, you can swing by later as well. I'll be here manning the counter in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Yaolu
dialogues.text: Hey there! Would you like to try your hand at "Immortal Combat"?

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: Simply put, this is a game where rattan figures will engage in combat under our command. This is a game with quite the long history on our end.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: In the past, we would fashion our own little rattan figures, control them, and pit them in combat against one another.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: Some veteran players could even have them perform real swordplay.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: But later... Well, everyone found more fun things to play with, so this game fell to the wayside, with the rattan figures becoming purely commemorative items.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: But when I was little, I loved these little rattan figures. I would pester my family members to play with me, or help me make more figures.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: The ones my grandma made? Those were fantastic — she taught me everything I know about making them.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: Grandpa was skilled in crafts, and he'd use wood to carve all sorts of awesome weapons, arming my rattan figures to the teeth with them.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: My parents, too, would always find time to play with me no matter how busy they were...

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: And who knows? Perhaps the rattan figures I'd always put on my desk came to the Ministry of Civil Affairs's notice eventually...

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: And that might be why they opened up a booth related to the figures... which is, of course, "Immortal Combat."

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: You can be sure that I volunteered myself to take charge of it the moment I heard the news — and they agreed.

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: So, would you like to give it a try? Trust me, it's great fun! Not to mention how each of them was fashioned by Lan Yan herself, and she's a real pro!

choices.text: I don't have time at the moment...

response.speaker: Yaolu
response.text: Don't worry. Just go ahead and take care of whatever you need to, and come down to the booth whenever you feel like playing.
